text:
LOVE THIS ICE MAKER!! I sure drink a lot of water now. I hated water before the ice maker! Love ❤️❤️
I started this review 4 years ago and never posted it till now. This ice maker was fast, efficient, noisy and it worked fine for 4 years.
I’m glad to replace it with hopefully a quiet model.
Stopped working after 9 months.
We loved it!  It made ice cubes very fast and there were 3 size options!

Ice Machine quit working right at 6 months. I had it plugged in and running constantly. I am waiting on warranty information from Amazon as I was also unsuccessful in contacting C&A Marketing. If they replace this with minimal out of pocket expense, I will update this review and raise the rating.

Update: 09/30/16 - Amazon was able to send me manufacturer number - 866-849-3049. I called once and left a voicemail. I have now been waiting for 1.5 hours for somebody to answer. I would not recommend this product to anybody.

I purchased this machine on Dec 27,2015. I quit working this week --Oct 4 2018. I am very upset about about its poor quality and short working time. I don't know if it is covered by any warranty
The freezer rods quit working!!

It was very difficult to set the timer on this machine. The timer had to be properly set to turn the ice to maker on and off. I hated the time setting process. To add to the frustration the time setter used military time!
More trouble than it was worth!!!
Love it
Bought for son in law. He uses everyday.. Loves it so much..
Returned this.  Directions were difficult to understand.  Didn't make ice quickly

Mine quite working after 8 months. I found out from Ivation that there is a 12 month warranty where they will repair or replace the machine, HOWEVER the cost of shipping the defective unit to Ivation is on you. Given the size and weight of the unit, I am guessing the shipping will be at least $45, whic is almost half of what I paid for the unit.

If you are interested in a warranty repair, email a copy of your receipt to info@myivation.com with a note that you are requesting exchange under warranty.

I'm still debating whether I will invest another $45 in getting a replacement or try another brand.

Ice quality low
Performance unpredictable
Now it has stopped making ice completely.
Don't waste your money! Worked until the one year warranty expired and then quit.
Great product once you get the hang of operations
Love this Gadget!  It makes perfect ice cube of three different sizes.  You can even set a timer, so you have ice waiting for you at just the right time.  I wouldn't be without one of these now.
It worked fine for the first 2 months and then it just stopped working all of a sudden one day.

I ordered my first ice maker 12/2014 worked great absolutely loved it. Loved it so much that I ordered another one 2/2016 because i kept finding little bits of something in the reservoir no matter how many times I cleaned it. (I thought it was something I was doing wrong). So on to the new one after awhile same thing with the bits of whatever.  Clean it really good  (I clean often any way according to the instructions) & now the thing just will not freeze the water. The machine sucks up the water but that's it. So after two machines 1st one $179.00 & 2nd  $99.00 I give up. Bought one from Walmart for $119.00 with a 2 year warranty. If this one breaks at least I can get a replacement.
It does make ice, but it has loud unneeded beeping!!!
It does make ice, but it has loud unneeded beeping!!!
It worked for a few days off and on. It does not work. I sent it back
It's ok... didn't preform properly. Had to press the buttons to many times.

I love this unit, although the instructions were a little confusing, but once I got the set up right, it worked really well.
I had it disconnected for a while, (3 months) and it stopped working when I reconnected it. I think the problem was a little piece of hardware that had gotten dislodged and I didn't know how to fix it or where it came from. I contacted the seller, and because it was still under warranty, they replaced the unit for me. So far, it is wonderful.I have no other ice machine to compare it to, however, this one is great!!!!
The best little Ice Maker I have bough. I have bought two now one for us and one for a friend.
All is well.
Best small ice maker ever!! This little one is awesome, does exactly as described! Use it in a small business and keeps me stocked with ice.

Product worked for 5 month and stopped working.  I called and they gave me instructions to take a photo of the error message and send to an email address.  I did as they requested and have not heard from anyone.  I purchased 3 year extra warranty with this product but they won't satisfy any warranty until the manufacturer warranty expires.. So I am out of luck I guess.  $99 for 5 months of use.. bags of ice from the gas station would have been less expensive.
When my refrigerator ice-make went kaput and I was expecting company, I decided to try this.  Works as advertised.

I had to change my review of this product.  We purchased this item in April 2017, LOVED it.  It made ice quickly and was easy to grab on counter top to fill a glass.  Perfect when company was over.  However; this product stopped making ice in August 2017, 4 months later.  It goes through the motions of trying to dump ice, but there is no ice.  I believe the pump is out.  Can't find a manual online or parts to replace.
The first one we got did not work. Amazon got a new one to us in 2 days and is working. Thank you Amazon!!!
Must have for RV life!! Love this machine. Makes ice quickly and what ice is not used melts and water is filtered back through to make more ice when needed.

Very good product and does make ice as expected

A little noisy and the ice tends to melt together but overall pretty good !!

i was shopping online for the best deal on a portable ice maker. Most were much more expensive without the key features that are available on this machine. The digital display is fantastic and the ability to choose between 3 sizes of cubes is awesome. When it arrives be sure to let it sit for at least 30 minutes and the manufacturer suggest cleaning out the inside of the water reservoir and ice basket. The speed at which the ice is made is amazing. I like to set it on small so I can crunch on the cubes. The timer setting for on/off time is great; the ice maker also stops when the basket is full or when the water reservoir is low/empty. You can also shut the machine off manually. I was going to spring out over $175 for a Coca-Cola memorabilia but saw this and said..."I have to have it"...

I just wanted to make a batch of ice cubes. I don't need any clock to set. I had trouble setting it. I did manage to make a batch of ice cubes , which worked great BUT it doesn't tell me how to shut it off. The water ran out and I didn't need any more than it gave me, and I couldn't find how to shut off.I don't know if I'm getting dumb in my old age.(81). I was afraid to start pushing the 1-4 . Is there someone who can walk me thru setting it up w/o programming it? (414)209-8112. marji3623@gmail or email me with help. PLEASE! Marji
Took this to make ice in Death Valley and it worked beautifully for us.  The first round of cubes are a bit wimpy, but after that they are good and solid and last surprisingly well.
Love my ice maker!!! Love that i can always have ice ready for me

Right so I've had this machine for quite a while. First let me say, yes it does make ice, in three different sizes. That's the good bit. Now come the not so good bits.

1) The instruction manual seems as if it was written first in another language and then pasted into Google Translate and voila! Non, c'est ne pas bien! The manual gives the most vague and generalised instructions, not just for operation, but for care and maintenance as well.

2) In spite of my best efforts (i.e. setting the time, not setting the time, setting the timed on/off feature, not setting the timed on/off feature, etc.), the thing beeps at really inconvenient times, say in the middle of the night.

3) The clock is in 24-hour display only with no option to change to a 12-hour a.m. / p.m. display.

4) CLEANING - This is why I rated it two stars. I've been wiping out the ice maker receptacle as per the instructions (as useful as they are - not!) regularly. Taking the whole thing (it is heavy for my standard) over to the sink to flush and drain out the back, etc...well recently, and for the first time, (was wearing my reading glasses) I saw the inside to the back, behind the evaporator, and to my absolute horror there was black mold everywhere. I tried a variety of brushes, different sizes and shapes to get to the area, no joy. I had to get my tool kit out, find the bit small enough for the screws and take the bloody top off! Even after all that, it took thr
Good product for the price

Worked for about 6 months. Although in that time, it was obnoxiously loud while making ice. It also has a speaker that beeps when it's full (and it is annoyingly LOUD). The clock/timer function has NEVER worked (I can set it but it is fast and gains about 15 minutes every other day, but it doesn't matter because even with the time function on it chooses to make ice literally whenever it wants to). There is absolutely ZERO manuals or product support included or available online. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. You're better off going with literally any other brand.
Owned this ice machine for less than seven months and it has stopped functioning. It was great while it lasted.

This is my second unit. Works great for about 4 months. Then it stops working. The mechanism that dumps the ice and pushes it forward failed both times.  Loved the production so I got another. Same thing happened. Never again.
Works very fast.

For the money, I was very happy with the performance.  Took this on a hunting trip for drink ice and cooler ice and after running on the generator for about 90 minutes or so it had produced a full bin of ice.  Easy to clean and easy to run.
did not work

Couldn't understand the menu at all. Couldn't figure out of way of turning it off except unplugging. Instructions limited.  But it worked and worked until it didn't.  It made ice cubes day and night; tecycling the water from melted cubes.  Had a good two to three months run out of it, then it just stopped.  So mad, just now months later finally dealing with the warranty.  I'll let you know if they come through or not.
Product broke after less than 1 year use.
Don't waste your money piece of junk
This has worked out very well, so far.  Shipped promptly and was well packed.  Works as described, seems to be well made.  As long is holds up, we expect to be very happy with the purchase.
Totally amazing, my kids can even make the ice.  It's so easy and starts making ice within 6 minutes!!!
The machine works properly. But the ONLY problem it is not making ice cubes at all.
Works Great! It's Fast and also Fun to watch! :)
Purchased in May and by December it stop making ice. Cant return item and cant locate a local repair shop to get it fixed. Amazon website was no help it locating repair shop.

I'm rating this a four on quality.  It runs as expected and we've had no issues with it.  From a practical standpoint though, it's kind of a waste of time and money.  I was really excited to have the ability to make ice while camping, but you have to monitor it to remove the ice before it melts again and it takes quite a while to accumulate enough ice to do anything with, other than maybe to add a little ice to a drink.  The ice is also a little soft because of how the machine works, so when you put it in an ice bin in the freezer, it all tends to freeze together.  For the price, you can buy a lot of bags of ice.  I wouldn't buy it again.  Not useful enough for price, time and frankly storage space needed to carry it around.
This ice maker is the best thing you can have for not being able to have ice in the freezer you can make and put it in something and put it in the freezer
Delivered ahead of time, worked on reading the directions and comments on line. Drain under the device would be nice if it had easier access. Overall very satisfied with ice and device.

We got tired of buying ice. Since we purchased this machine we have not bought ice again. Makes plenty and have used it almost everyday. Was a great purchase . This is an update. We've  owned this now for about 5 months. And you can guess my next sentence. It completely quit working. So in the trash it goes. I will not recommend this product to anyone. What a costly price of equipment.
Works as Promised. Will recommend to friends and family.

The big Ice machines by the company cafeteria are always either empty or broken and is several minutes walk away. So we waited for the price to come down on this Ice Maker which seemed to be getting good reviews. Fast shipping by Amazon as usual and voila! We have ice!

The box did not have any "This Side Up" markings, so I followed the advice of other reviewers and waited a couple of days for the internal fluids to settle before taking it in to work, pouring in some water and starting it up. First batch of 9 cubes came in less than 5 minutes, and they kept coming until the basket was full. Water gets pumped up into a mini reservoir and forms around cold metal "fingers". When the ice is done, the water is drained back, the fingers heat briefly so the ice falls off, and the ice gets dumped in the basket for use.

Lights on top indicate Basket Full, Low Water, Large or Small Cube Size and Power On/Off. Simply pour some water into the reservoir under the removable basket when the water gets low. It holds about a half gallon of water. There is a little plug in the bottom so that you can easily drain the water if you need to. Comes with a plastic scoop so everyone doesn't touch everyone else's ice. ;)

With the convenience of the ice maker being right there, we started putting in fewer cubes at a time (we used to pack them full of ice)... fewer water refills needed. For a group of 5 coworkers, who start work at staggered tim

Birthday present for husband and he loves it! Fun and easy to use and doesn't take up a lot of room. Makes about a cup and a half of ice in five minutes and will keep on making ice. Now he won't have to buy bags of ice and store them in the freezer.
We love it, it makes great ice. We just bought a new refrigerator and it doesn't make much ice so this is perfect. I bought it for my husbands birthday.
WE LOVE IT

Worked great straight out of the box.....day 31 the "out of water" light came on so I went to fill it....it wasn't out of water.  Pulled the plug, drained the water, added new water and powered it on....made 2 rounds of ice then water light back on.  Basically have to power off and on every 2 ice cycles.  I unplugged it for a day to see if that might reset it.....plugged it back in and guess what...now after 1 ice cycle the "bucket full" light is on.....it is now alternating between inaccurate "bucket full" and "water low" errors.  Needless to say, very unhappy with this subpar product...what a waste of $100. Not looking forward to having to spend more money to get a working product.
Titch louder than would be my dream, but works perfect!
This is a great product very happy with it, only downside is is it's very large and takes up significantcounterspace
Purchased as a gift for my sister for Mother's Day because her ice maker in her freezer really broke this time. Right now I have it running on my kitchen counter and it works great!
This is perfect for my office. We have no kitchen and it's difficult to keep ice around. This makes it fast, it's pretty darn quiet and my fellow employees love it too.
Works as described, delivered fast.
Bought this for the office and everyone loves it.  Makes ice very quickly and takes up little space.
Love it.
Works great so far.
It is perfect for what I needed!  Makes good size ice cubes for drinks. I keep a bucket full of ice in my camper freezer and keep it running for refills.

Very happy this the machine until it stopped working after 3 months.  Manufacturer will allow me to send it back for repair or excange, but only if I pay shipping an a 21 lb package.  Very disappointed with their customer service.  I do not recommend.

Mixed reviews from previous people and we were not lucky.  Package arrived., nice size and design however the "low water" indicator came on repeatedly despite my best attempts to reset, fill with more/less water.  So item had to be returned but that process was flawless.

Bought this unit for the cabin up nort and it works real nice. The cubes that come out of the hopper are wet, so if you're going to put them in the freezer they will stick together. Just get a screwdriver or ice pick and you can make a nice cocktail. I have had this unit about 6 months and the fan is starting to run loud, hope it holds up
Only had it up and running for a week or so, but so far, so good.

We do not have an ice maker built into our freezer so we either buy bags and keep it in the freezer in the garage or fill up the ice cube trays.  I just wanted ice when I wanted ice and not get upset that no one tells me that they took the last of the ice in the freezer or when no one refills the ice trays.  I mean, is that too much to ask?!?!?  The answer is an ice maker.  This little ice maker has been working for us.  I bought this in March and have had it on (pretty much non stop) since then.  We only use the large ice and, for a family of four, it is never empty.  It sits on our counter next to the fridge.  I cannot say enough good things about this work horse.
Fast and easy ice maker. Perfect for my needs.
Sure makes ice fast.
We've been making ice like crazy, and the machine works like a champ! No problems, and very fast shipping too!
Received it plugged it in,added water and it doesn't work!! Immediately the low water light comes on and the water tank is fulll. Returning it

This ice maker does make good ice, nice shape and size. Works great in the blender for mixed drinks. It's easy to use and overall I do like it. The couple of complaints I have....it does not hold much ice and needs to be emptied often. For the size of the machine you'd think it would hold a lot more. Also the ice maker does not keep the ice very cold inside of the machine, the ice is melted by the time I empty it which makes it stick together in a big chunk. In fairness my kitchen has been very hot with the hot summer temperatures. My husband does seem to enjoy breaking it up with the ice pick so it's not a total failure.

I will just say wow. I had apprehension about purchasing it, but now I keep my work cooler full of ice. I fill it with water, relax do other stuff, come back and the basket is full of ice. Fill it up again, and after a couple times doing that, I can fill my work cooler up no problem.
This product is pretty awesome. It makes ice quickly, uses very little water, and is convenient.

After spending over 300 dollars on our refrigerator ice maker and it still didn't work, I shut the water off and said enough of this. I bought the Ivation ice maker over six months ago. I have had no problems with it at all. It takes about 45 minutes to make a basket full, so if you are going to make a lot of ice ahead you have to plan your time. I would certainly recommend this unit.

I bought this machine a year and a half ago. It has made ice like a champ, ever six minutes, spitting out perfectly sized cube, in my choice of sizes. Today I noticed it had stopped working. Water level were fine, motor runs, just won't fill and won't freeze. The biggest problem seems to be that there is a large amount of calcium build up. I have a lot minerals in my water so this isn't unusual. Even though I always use filtered water, it's hard to remove it all, and after 14 1/2 months, it's done.

This was a great machine. I think it might have lasted me longer had I turned it off now and then, and maybe checked it more often for the mineral buildup. But it's a great machine and I cannot complain about how well it has worked. I wish it had lasted longer but I take at least a good part of the blame.

Because there is no way to find out how to do maintenance on this machine and there is no manufacturer website that offers even a manual, I have dropped my rating to 3 stars. The was a good machine while it lasted but there is no way to clean the filter that I can see, there are no manuals available online that I can find.

I love this so much.  I have absolutely no reservations about recommending this ice maker. My favorite features: 1) Recycles melted ice in order to keep making ice; 2) Fairly quiet operation; 3) If water is low or ice basket is full, the machine automatically suspends operation.

It worked for six months of pure bliss then quite working.  I enjoyed it everyday but the day it stopped was the day I cried.  It should have lasted longer.  I bought another brand for my brother for Christmas and it is still going strong.
got one in my motorhome, condo and gave one to a friend.

It is so quiet you don't know its here until it dumps ice, which it does about every 6 minutes or so. The ice it makes is easy to munch on, even the large cubes. So far, we're lovin' it and its doing the job. We're expecting family for both Christmas breakfast and later for dinner, so the ice maker will get a work out tomorrow, plus we've been able to bag several gallon bags up. Definitely, will recommend to others.
love this thing.  We watch it make ice all day long.

After 5 months it stopped working. The tray full light comes on, when the tray is empty. No customer service info readily available through AMAZON or on the web. Eventually, after a lot of work, got the contact for the service/warranty. Never got a live person and never got a call back or email response. Several months later, finally got a live person, but was told that the device was one week over the warranty period (4 months after we had first contacted them). AMAZON should not let this product be sold without the warranty information and the customer service for the seller being readily available and transparent.

Worked great for 6 months. Now it just squeals and makes loud noises and does not produce any ice.  Now let's see if I can get anywhere with the manufacturer, as Amazon does not wish to help.

Good purchase. A couple helpful tips... Pour in cold water into reservoir for faster making ice cubes.  I just used tap water and when pouring it out of the ice amker I noticed it had been chilled by the machine in the reservoir itself.  Also if the reservoir is filled to "max" then the ice cubes get plunged into a water bath which, of course, melts them faster.  This ice maker makes a lot of cubes with a small amount of water. Next time I'll fill it just a little less.  It was bigger out of the box than what I expected after doing lots of research, but others do come bigger.  All in all it's a great looking item and a good size for our motorhome.  Hope this was helpful for others.

My GE Hotpoint model no: HSS25IFMD WW fridge has gone out several times. The first time, it was the main board.

It recently had a defrost issue again. I assumed the problem was the same as before, so I made the mistake of replacing the main control board again prior to first replacing several smaller, inexpensive parts. The board and the heating element were replaced but did not fix the problem. Then I replaced the defrost thermostat and the freezer temperature sensor. I'm not exactly sure which one of these two fixed my defrost problem, but since they were both inexpensive, I replaced both. My fridge works perfectly again.

A couple things to keep in mind, you will need some wire strippers, wire nuts, and electrical tape to do these repairs correctly. Replacing this part is not time consuming or labor intensive at all. For installation instructions, search Youtube for installation videos.

***IMPORTANT***
Make sure you defrost the freezer coils before you expect this repair to take effect.

My defrost problem was as a result of my freezer not going into defrost mode as it should. After installing these new components, I expected the defrost cycle to start immediately, which would have been evident by seeing the defrost heater come on. This did not happen which made me sick, because I thought my repair was a failure. It was not until I defrosted the freezer coils and started the freezer again that I saw the freezer go into defrost
Great  it works
Not much to say, was the part I needed.
Does exactly what it needs to do. Thankful for the length of attached wire to make splicing easy.
Fixed my refrigerator from freezing,fast delivery
Worked great

My refridgerator works great now, My fridge would get alot of frosty ice along the back wall and when i took the back panel of the freezer everything was frozen and this was due to this sensor not working, so the defrost heater don't turn on to defrost the ice that is building up.
right on time and original product

I also had problems with ice buildup on the evaporator went through some troubleshooting steps to find the thermistor on the evaporator was out of spec when tested at specified conditions (15~16-kOhms @ 32F; 4~5-kOhms @ room temp). Replaced with this item and everything works again, be sure to fully defrost the evaporator before putting back into service.

Installed on GE Profile Artica PSS25SGNA BS

problem solved by this cheap fix. My Ge Pfs22sisbss temperatures for fridge compartment and freezer fluctuated erratically. Freezer was cooling, but the fridge wasn't cool. I did some online research about this particular Ge model and most pointed to the motherboard, defrost heater, and the thermistor. I ordered three thermistors and replaced all. Now the fridge is working properly. I didn't need the motherboard and defrost heater.
Fast shipping... Item as described
Fit perfectly.
It worked!!
The item was as described and worked perfectly.
it works!
Replaced the fan motor along with temperature sensor. Fridge working perfectly.  Initial problem was that ice was building up on the back of the freezer and it stopped cooling one day.
Worked to repair a defrost problem on my fridge.

This is a generic replacement sensor. The picture shows a genuine GE part but what I received is a generic knockoff part that is not a genuine GE part. The quality of this part is subpar to the actual GE part. Save yourself time & money, get a genuine GE part. These knockoffs will work but will not last!!
very good work well  ill buy it agin
Works good do our frig.
